fullPassage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and far-reaching influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.

questions.passage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and far-reaching influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people __________ as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① gave up(포기했다): 위인들이 평범하게 출발했다는 맥락과 반대

✅ ② started out: 'these people __________ as students, workers, and citizens'에서 위대한 인물들도 우리처럼 학생·근로자·시민으로 '시작했다(started out)'는 맥락 ←정답

❌ ③ stood still(가만히 있었다): 발전 맥락과 반대

❌ ④ fell behind(뒤처졌다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: started out as ~ = ~로서 시작했다

questions.passage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and __________ influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① short-lived(단명한): 위인들의 영향력 맥락과 반대

❌ ② well-hidden(잘 숨겨진): 영향력 맥락과 부적절

❌ ③ little-known(거의 알려지지 않은): 역사적 중요성과 반대

✅ ④ far-reaching: 'the historical importance and __________ influence of these individuals'에서 역사적 중요성과 함께 언급되는, 위인들의 '광범위한(far-reaching)' 영향력이 적절 ←정답
det.tip: far-reaching influence = 광범위한 영향력
